_source: mi/REPORT.md Response Schema + mi/scripts/mi_parse.py + verified against fixtures/MI/*.html (see mechanical check in yield notes)
card_variants:
A) O*Net Code: ..
EMP - City, MI, zip - Posted date; B) same with NO (no O*NET, 15/75 rows). Parser must handle both (mi/scripts/mi_parse.py)

detail_page.company: title string 'at {employer} in {city}, {ST} {zip}' (lblCompanyName appears only in page JS getElementById, not as a rendered id in the 414569021 capture — [uncertain: dedicated company element id unpinned])
detail_page.title: span/div id MainContent_lblJobTitle text e.g. 'ASST STORE MGR in DRYDEN MI S16670'
detail_page.webforms: detail is itself a WebForms page (own __VIEWSTATE, 6 occurrences); no txtJobCount/result-title

no_json_feed: no JSON representation anywhere; t3 netlog (105 records) shows zero data XHRs (mi/samples/t3_netlog_20261026T191204Z.jsonl); bundle has no feed endpoint (mi/samples/t1_bundles_scripts_20261026.js)

pager.slot_ids: a href javascript:__doPostBack('ctl00$MainContent$pageTop<slot>','') / pageBtm (top/bottom identical); slots are sliding-window positions, not page numbers
pager.slot_text_rule: read displayed anchor text (numeric) or glyphicon «/» slots; post the slot whose text == startIndexNum+1, else post slot 5 (advance)
pager.start_index: input#MainContent_startIndexNum value (1-based current page; measured 1->5->7 across mi/samples/t1replay_pager_*.html)

quoting_quirk: attribute quotes flip between " (wire) and ' (DOM serialization); dates not zero-padded (10/8/2026); state is 'MI' or literal 'Michigan' (mi/scripts/mi_parse.py handles all three)

search_cards.city: div.result-place text part between ' - ' separators, before state (e.g. 'Ann Arbor')
search_cards.detail_url: div.result-title > a href '../job-details/JobCode/{id}' (robots-disallowed; do not fetch without counsel sign-off)
search_cards.employer: text before first ' - ' in div.result-place after the <b> block (e.g. 'The University of Michigan')
search_cards.job_code_dedupe_key: div.result-title id attr == a[name] == href JobCode id (9 all-digit chars, e.g. '417418550')
search_cards.onet_nullable: div.result-place b text minus 'O*Net Code:' prefix (absent 15/75 = 20%; e.g. '21-1012.00 Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors')
search_cards.state: [A-Z]{2} OR literal 'Michigan' (two encodings in the wild)
search_cards.title: div.result-title > a text (or a[title] attr)
search_cards.veteran_flag: img.veteran-flag[title] inside card, e.g. 'MVAA Certified Veteran Friendly Employer' (nullable, unmeasured frequency)

stable_id: job_code (9-digit; 75/75 distinct in mi/data/probe.sqlite; secondary key (job_code, posted))
total_count: p#txtJobCount text regex ^([\d,]+) Job\(s\) (e.g. '61152'; drifted 61154->61149 over 19:12-19:45Z)
